publisher.name: Lobbying Disclosure Act public disclosure system

dataset.name: LDA printable filing documents
dataset.description: Publisher-rendered LD-1, LD-2, and LD-203 HTML or PDF documents preserving form-level and as-filed evidence that can differ from API JSON.

acquisition.pagination: None. One document URL is published per filing UUID.

partitions.name: filing_uuid
partitions.source: filing_document_url on the corresponding API record
partitions.purpose: Capture and compare the source document for each new or changed filing version.

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound retries with response-size and redirect limits; never replace a prior document digest after a failed or wrong-content response.

physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve empty form controls, unchecked controls, absent sections, blank text, and parser failures as distinct states.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Content type, document title, form kind, normalized DOM element and control paths, and this contract version.

identity.occurrence_locator: snapshot digest + filing_uuid + representation + retrieval ordinal
identity.record_version: filing_uuid + media type + SHA-256 of exact response bytes
identity.duplicate_policy: Retain every distinct byte version; a changed document under a known filing UUID creates a new immutable document version and blocks unchecked projection.

children.locator: document version + form kind + source line number or named control + deterministic DOM path
document version + source section number + one-based section ordinal

time_fields.meaning: As-filed reporting year and checked reporting period.
As-filed termination checkbox and termination date.
As-filed semiannual year and checked period.
As-filed date for one contribution or expense item.
As-rendered filing signature timestamp; retain separately from API dt_posted and Legal Tender retrieval time.

money_fields.meaning: Checked under-threshold band or reported income/expense point, qualified by reporting method and the precision rule effective for the period.
money_fields.unit: USD source-defined band or lossless reported decimal

code_fields.meaning: LD-1, LD-2, or LD-203 form kind and checked filing state.
As-rendered label; API code and pinned constants remain the canonical machine code evidence.

rules: Preserve exact document bytes independently from API JSON.
As-filed names, addresses, contacts, agency text, amount-band controls, and form structure are document assertions; current nested API masters do not replace them.
A null API income or expense is not zero when the printable form checks the less-than-5000 band.
A printed numeric income or expense is a reported point whose economic precision remains governed by the applicable reporting method and period; lossless parsing does not make it a ledger amount.
One LD-1 form-level issue-code list and shared specific-issue section must not become duplicate activities merely because the API emits one object per code.
API government-entity IDs and constant names remain standardized publisher assertions; printable agency text remains separate as-filed evidence.
A truncated printable LD-203 item label does not replace the API contribution type code.
The printable LD-203 form does not expose original-versus-amendment status in the sampled pair; retain API filing_type as separate evidence.
No HTML parser output may replace or mutate the exact source document.

revisions.publisher_model: Each API filing UUID resolves to one printable URL, but the bytes can change in place and must be re-observed by digest.
revisions.effective_projection: The sampled LD-2 amendment family renders complete forms, but one family is insufficient to accept a universal full-replacement rule. LD-203 amendment status depends on API evidence in the sampled pair.

checks.rule: Status, media type, redirects, byte length, and digest satisfy the document acquisition contract.
The document title and required form controls identify LD-1, LD-2, or LD-203 as expected from the API endpoint.
The requested URL and corresponding API record identify the same filing UUID and representation.
Every recognized form control or repeating section becomes a field assertion or explicit parse issue.
API/document differences publish as explicit comparison states and never resolve silently.
Changed bytes under one filing UUID require review or replay before derived document fields publish.

scenarios: LD-1 as-filed registrant and client fields
multiple issue codes sharing one form section
historical names differ from current API masters
under-threshold expense absent from API amount
historical employer name differs from current API master
source item order is not chronological
print label truncated relative to API constant
printable form does not expose amendment status

use.retention: Preserve every exact document byte version and its retrieval manifest indefinitely.
use.disclaimer: Senate Office of Public Records cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from LDA.gov.
